text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Kikuka Sho, King
Halo shows
up with her head held high
at a racecourse in her
signature
racewear.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She launches into her puzzling
call-and-response
routine, drawing the
attention of the surrounding

reporters—all according to plan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Taking advantage of this moment, she
announces
her plan to run in the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen
with hopes that
this news will once again steer the
public
gaze her way.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The prideful Umamusume makes her
intentions
clear—she has now chosen her
own path, devoid
of any influence from
her mother or anyone else.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
